item.title: Continuously Updated Digital Elevation Model (CUDEM) Mosaic: Tiled Color Hillshade Visualization
item.description: Tiled hillshade layer of a seamless bathymetry/topography mosaic of CUDEM digital elevation models at NOAA/NCEI.

item.title: U.S. Coastal Relief Models (Dynamic Image Service)

item.title: U.S. Coastal Relief Models (Tiled Color Hillshade Visualization)
item.description: A tiled color hillshade visualization of NCEI's 1 arc-second Coastal Relief Models (published in 2023).

item.title: ETOPO 2022 Tiled Elevation Layer (10x vertical exaggeration)
item.description: A tiled elevation layer for the ETOPO 2022 15 arc-second global relief model from NOAA NCEI. This layer has a 10x vertical exaggeration (for visualization purposes), and uses the WGS84 Geographic, version 2 tiling scheme.

item.title: ETOPO 2022 Global Scene
item.description: A global web scene portraying the ETOPO 2022 global relief model from NOAA NCEI. For visualization purposes, a 10x vertical exaggeration is used.

item.title: ETOPO 2022 Hillshade Basemap (WGS 84)
item.description: A color hillshade visualization of the ETOPO 2022 15 arc-second global relief model from NOAA NCEI. This version uses the WGS84 Geographic, version 2 tiling scheme.

item.title: ETOPO 2022 Hillshade Basemap
item.description: A color hillshade visualization of the ETOPO 2022 15 arc-second global relief model from NOAA NCEI.
